decisions.decision: Resource-limit extension (spec I9, D1/ADR-0002): pi has no byte limits and reads the stream to its terminal. At the boundary the same cases match pi (PIDIFF-P01-E08-*-at-limit-stream). Asserted on all four entries by the offline E2E TestByteLimits.

decisions.decision: pi's own contract (types.ts AssistantMessageEvent) makes partial the shared live response-so-far, not an event-time snapshot. Both sides serialize it when the consumer receives the event; pi's single-threaded runner happens to reach every event before producing the next, while barness's producer runs concurrently with the consumer without backpressure (spec I8/I9), so its view may already hold later deltas, blocks and block ends (including their signatures). Event-own fields (contentIndex, delta, end content), the terminal message and the Result are compared strictly; the live-view contract (one shared view, never behind the event being read, synchronized snapshots, settles on the final message) is asserted by the E01 offline E2E TestStreamLifecycle. A partial missing on barness or differing in identity fields stays pending.

decisions.decision: Spec-defined extension (spec I6, ADR-0001: native state is replayed only under a trusted envelope; without one it is downgraded by the cross-model rules and the call goes ahead). pi has no envelope and replays same-model signed and redacted thinking from any history; barness replays it only when the host vouched for the message (TrustNativeState) or barness produced it in-process. Restored without that, the blank signed thinking and the redacted block are dropped and the turn keeps its text, and Result metadata counts one noEnvelope downgrade (barness-only, not part of the pi message). The trusted replay of the same history matches pi exactly (PIDIFF-P02-signed-empty-and-redacted-stream). Asserted by the offline E2E TestAnthropicHistory.

decisions.decision: pi's own contract (types.ts AssistantMessageEvent) makes partial the shared live response-so-far, not an event-time snapshot; the same decision as openai-responses, anthropic-messages and google-generative-ai events[*].partial. Both sides serialize it when the consumer receives the event; pi's single-threaded runner reaches every event before producing the next, while barness's producer runs concurrently with the consumer without backpressure (spec I8/I9), so its view may already hold later deltas, blocks, the block ends pi emits after the stream, the reasoning details signature, usage from later chunks, the response id and model and the finish reason; pi's view also carries its streaming scratch fields (partialArgs, streamIndex) on open tool calls, which it deletes before the call ends. Event-own fields (contentIndex, delta, end content), the terminal message and the Result are compared strictly; the live-view contract is asserted by the E01 offline E2E TestStreamLifecycle. A partial missing on barness or differing in identity fields stays pending.
decisions.ref: spec I8 累计部分响应; issues/04; issues/20; ai/e2e/stream_lifecycle_test.go

DeepSeek's compat (pi's requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages) then gives the downgraded turn the empty reasoning_content every assistant message of a reasoning model carries, where pi, which trusts any history, replays the streamed reasoning. routes.decision: Native synchronous stateless Google Interactions image generation and ordered inline reference editing are outside frozen pi 1.0.0 routes. Public prompt-then-images input deliberately omits interleaved content and masks; shared strict png/jpeg/webp input validation is narrower than the protocol MIME list. Every P09 fixture skips pi differential and never counts as a differential pass. Own live/catalog confirmation remains issue 14.

DeepSeek × Responses (P05) is an access path outside the frozen pi routes: pi 0.87.1 routes DeepSeek only through openai-completions (providers/deepseek.ts). It reuses barness's Responses adapter with DeepSeek's own capabilities (no store, include, prompt cache or service tier; full input history) and is proven by the official-protocol fixtures in ai/e2e/testdata/deepseek-responses, run offline by TestDeepSeekResponses*; none of them runs as a differential case and none counts as a differential pass. Its live evidence is issue 23's smoke.
